text.description_html:
Acorn WTFBI-Lever, Warwick Pre-Drilled Entry Set with Equis Lever

The Warwick Entry Set with Equis Lever is a stunning piece that beautifully imitates the craftsmanship that door hardware had in the days before mass manufacturing. This Warwick Entry Set is forged in black iron. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the natural weathering of iron. The Warwick Pre-Drilled Entry Set with Equis Lever decorative style is great indoors or outdoors. It will fit most pre-drilled doors.

Single Cylinder Handleset: A key operates the deadbolt from the exterior while a thumbturn operates it from the interior. The latch is operated by a lever from the exterior and interior.

Specifications for the Warwick Rough Iron Handleset:

  • Finish: Rough Texture Black Iron
  • Length:15"
  • Width: 3"
  • Projection: 2-3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" or 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Sold individually. This door push plate is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
